releases.name: BALL x PIT: Risen Ballbylon
releases.summary:
You’re used to the lift descending into the depths of the pit – but now it’s going up. In this massive expansion for smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite BALL x PIT, rise above the abyss to reach Risen Ballbylon, which floats high in the sky above. Each level is a layer of the former city, where the population has been warped by the effects of the meteor.

Risen Ballbylon is the biggest and most transformative expansion for BALL x PIT yet, adding a wealth of new characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, buildings, and levels, dramatically expanding the possibilities of a run and introducing fresh new gameplay mechanics to test even the most hardened veterans of the pit. Will you rise to the challenge?

releases.name: Sonic Pico Park
releases.summary:
The latest entry in the PICO PARK series is a collaboration with SEGA's Sonic the Hedgehog!

Sonic the Hedgehog, celebrating its 35th anniversary this year, joins the latest entry in the PICO PARK series, a series that has sold over 8 million copies worldwide.

PICO CAT, the iconic character of the PICO PARK series, races through the world of PICO PARK with Sonic, the world’s fastest hedgehog, and his friends, including Tails, Knuckles, and Amy.

releases.name: Fakin' It XL
releases.summary:
Fakin’ It XL is all about lying your way to victory. Each round presents a simple prompt to all players on their phone or device like “raise your hand if you’ve ever pretended to like a gift you hated.” Everyone is on the same page – except for the faker, who must act as if they’ve received the same prompt as everyone else. Blend in by bluffing, grilling and deflecting through three rounds of interrogation to rack up points. Who knew that casting suspicion on others could be so personally rewarding?

Fakin’ It XL Features:

    New Hijinks-fueling Questions: Emojinal Damage and Thumb Luck mix things up alongside classic Fakin’ It question types for maximum friend-deceiving scheming:
    Emojional Damage challenges players to phrase their answers in the form of an emoji, such as “the emoji for a perfect gift for your boss” while the Faker only has a general category, like “the emoji of an object.” Now, can the Faker explain why giving their boss a shoe is a great idea.
    Thumb Luck asks everyone to weigh in with a quick thumbs up or down on three opinion-worthy items in a row, like “Working from Home” or “Dogs in Costumes”. The Faker has to choose without knowing the subject, though—can they justify their support for “Singing Along With Musicals”?
    Enhanced Remote Play: New options let your avatar take action for you, so the game works just as well on a video call as it does in your living room.
    XL-sized Parties: Now up to eight players can join the same game, making for the rowdiest Fakin’ It sessions ever. Good thing there’s plenty of new avatar choices for everyone to choose from, too.

releases.name: Autobahn Police Simulator 4
releases.summary:
Join the German police on the Autobahn and keep the roads safe in a fully drivable open world: unrestricted highways, winding country roads and lively towns. In Autobahn Police Simulator 4 you'll experience police duty in more depth than ever before. Conduct traffic stops, secure accident scenes and give chase when a suspect makes a run for it.

Patrol a fully drivable open world in a range of police vehicles, from the standard patrol car to an unmarked unit. Highways with rest stops and gas stations meet industrial zones, residential neighborhoods and small towns nestled between forests and mountains.

The radio calls, and you decide how to respond. Whether it's a routine stop, accident assistance or a high-speed pursuit with lights and sirens: every call brings new challenges. Act by the book and succeed on duty to earn reputation, climb the ranks and unlock new vehicles, equipment and police stations.

releases.name: Hazard Levels
releases.summary:
The deeper the rift, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

Hazard Levels is a brand new co-op survival horror from the team behind Sker Ritual.

releases.name: A Pet Shop After Dark
releases.summary:
A PET SHOP AFTER DARK is a horror point-and-click visual novel where you've taken on an odd job at a little pet shop. The owner tells you the job is easy - all you have to do is water the plants, feed the pets, and stay the night. 

There's just one thing - do NOT, under any circumstances, turn off the lights.

releases.name: Skygrid Courier
releases.summary: Soar through neon-lit skies delivering passengers to their destinations as you pilot a taxi ship with speed and precision! Skygrid Courier is a physics-based action puzzler that requires you to manage the momentum of your craft to avoid obstacles and safely reach targets around single-screen cityscapes. Pick up passengers one at a time and fly to the landing pad of their color-coded destinations including clinics, clubs, hotels and labs.Plan your route with quick-thinking strategy so you don’t run out of power for your ship and watch your shields! If you collide with objects or fly through hazards, a rough landing could cut your trip short! Choose from the task-based Mission mode to earn rewards, Arcade mode to race against the clock or Versus mode to compete in local multiplayer. Check your Hangar for unlockables as you progress, including alternate ships. Can you master the busy skyways of a neon-lit future, or will you crash and burn?• Deliver passengers across a neon cityscape!• Use momentum to your advantage but be careful not to crash.• Earn rewards for completing tasks and unlock new playable ships!• Test your skills across multiple game modes.• Enjoy physics-based puzzle gameplay in HD 2D style!This product entitles you to download both the digital PS4® version and the digital PS5® version of this game.

releases.name: Thronefall
releases.summary: A minimalist game about building and defending your little kingdom.

releases.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
releases.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

releases.name: Good President Simulator
releases.summary: Satirical political sim played from your desk. A nobody from the couch runs for office and signs laws by hand, drawing the signature yourself. Every law pleases some factions and enrages others. Tomorrow's paper will judge you, and the friends who paid your registration will come to collect.

releases.name: Super Astro Cat
releases.summary:
After getting their home planet destroyed by a meteor, the cats only option was to flee on a spaceship and embark on a journey to find a new suitable planet to colonize and live. Super Astro Cat is the hero with a mission of locating planets, exploring them and deciding the best one to live. Complete your mission and save the cat race from extinction!

Super Astro Cat is a 2D pixelart shoot 'n run with a jetpack mechanic. Activate the jetpack to control your movement on the air and use that to avoid obstacles and shoot asteroids and aliens with your mighty laser gun. Clear a path and explore all regions of each planet and then decide which planet you want the cats to live on. Complete all tasks and discover all the advantages and disadvantages of each planet and conquer all the areas. 

Choose wisely, as all their 9 lives are in your hands!

releases.name: Shrek 2 Remastered
releases.summary:
DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

Journey through the fairytale kingdom of Far Far Away from Shrek’s swamp to Fiona’s castle and everywhere in between, in a classic action-adventure experience inspired by the DreamWorks Animation movie. Play solo or with up to three friends in co-op, take control of your favorite Shrek heroes as you smash, throw and kick your way against iconic characters from the franchise.

Improved graphics: Everything has been rebuilt with better textures, enhanced UI, 4K resolution and cutscenes.

New features: Create timeless snapshots using the new Photo Mode and unlock cheats in Cheat Mode to make your playthrough a seamless experience.

Up to 4-player Couch Co-op, Online or Mixed: A cozy, team-based co-op action-adventure game, playable solo or up to 4-Player Couch Co-Op, Online Multiplayer, and Mixed Online Multiplayer & Couch Co-Op.

Immersive levels straight out of a fairytale: From Shrek’s swamp to the castle of Far Far Away, relive iconic moments from the movie featuring beloved characters and hidden Easter Eggs.

Swap heroes at any time: Swap your hero to battle enemies, conquer bosses, and solve environmental puzzles using their unique abilities to advance in the story.

releases.name: Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature
releases.summary:
Unpetrified: Echoes of Nature is a peaceful and reflective experience, filled with meaningful collectibles, unique emotion-driven interactions, and environmental puzzles. The orchestral soundtrack emphasizes an intimate storyline of unlikely friendship, loss, and love.

Travel across vast, beautifully diverse landscapes, each seamlessly blending into the next, filled with unique flora and fauna waiting to be discovered. The progress you make is reflected in the vibrant flowers blooming on the Golem’s back. There are many secrets and collectibles to discover, making for a rewarding exploration experience.

Solve puzzles that shape the environment around you. Use the Golem’s abilities to interact with the world in creative ways, unlocking new paths and uncovering secrets. Hidden within the remnants of a lost civilization lies the means to reclaim and rejuvenate Nature.

releases.name: RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition
releases.summary:
RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos.

RACCOIN: Chaos Max Edition blends the chaotic fun of classic arcade coin pushers with the element of roguelike deckbuilding. Combine special coins with powerful items to trigger satisfying synergies. It’s a nonstop dopamine rush packed into one unpredictable, coin dropping ride.

SYNERGIZING COINS & CHAOS
Discover all kinds of special coins during your runs! Combine Seed Coins with Water Coins to grow a money tree right inside your machine. Drop a Cat Coin to hunt down every last Rat Coin and rack up extra tickets. Need more points? Use a Multiply Coin to boost your score across the board. Too slow? Launch a Nuclear Coin to trigger a massive explosion and blast every coin forward at once!

CRAFT POWERFUL STRATEGIES WITH ITEMS
Stack multipliers, spawn coins with extra points, or simply shake the machine when you're running dry. Apply special plating to your favorite coins to enhance their effects and unlock even wilder combos.

DIFFERENT CHARACTERS, DISTINCT PLAYSTYLES
Play as one of several unique characters, each with their own set of themed coins and playstyle. Take on the role of a greedy raccoon manager who excels at math-based combos, or a quirky biologist who specializes in animal-based coins. Every character offers a fresh and wildly different way to play.

releases.name: Hard West 2
releases.summary: Hard West 2 is a journey to the heart of darkness in the American West. Take control of a supernatural posse and catch the mysterious Ghost Train. Outsmart, outcheat and outgun your enemies in this turn-based tactics game set in a Wild West world where nothing is as it seems.

releases.name: Ova Magica
releases.summary:
Stardew Valley meets Pokemon! Experience a wholesome farm game inspired by the classics! Train cute blob creatures, take care of your farm and make friends with the people of Clover Town.

You can grow everything from normal crops, berry bushes, and fruit trees, to heart fruit, weird herbs, and mushrooms from other dimensions! From your harvest you can cook high-quality food for your blobs to help them grow healthy and strong.

In the world of Ova Magica, people live side by side with these cute creatures, and you can raise them to be strong, loyal friends and sidekicks! To make your blobs stronger, you must feed them well, pet them and use specific skills in battles.

releases.name: Football Manager 27
releases.summary:
Foundations evolve in FM27, delivering firmer ground for your footballing adventure. From the moment your save begins, you’ll discover a cleaner, more intuitive, and easier to navigate experience, with new and returning features enhancing immersion and decision-making.

Sharpen your approach further with greater personalization and control of gameplay preferences, bookmarks, shortcuts and the introduction of tile customization to adapt the flow to your pace.

Your career is only part of the story as the football world beyond your club reawakens with returning and reimagined features that shape the action unfolding around you.

Get lost in the story as cup draws, transfer deadline day and an overhauled news feed keeps you plugged int

releases.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom
releases.summary: Welcome to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion - The Siege of Castle Doom, the second expansion of MARVEL Cosmic Invasion, which includes two new playable characters and a new game mode. Equipped with high-powered tech armor of his own design, along with occult skills and his genius intellect, Doctor Doom is the biggest threat in the universe... and Annihilus definitely won't be up to the challenge. Cosmic rays have given archeologist and explorer Susan Storm massive light-bending powers and force field manipulation. She now fights for the survival of the galaxy as The Invisible Woman, bringing in never-seen-before abilities to MARVEL Cosmic Invasion.

releases.name: Monster Train 2: The Punished
releases.summary: Turn pain into power with The Punished, a new clan joining the fight in Monster Train 2! Led by Archus, Darkness Incarnate, The Punished introduce a new risk-reward play style built around damaging your own units, harnessing their suffering, and turning it against your enemies.

releases.name: Warhammer Survivors
releases.summary:
Warhammer Survivors is a fast-paced roguelite survivors' game, pitting a host of iconic Warhammer characters against endless hordes of enemies from multiple Warhammer factions. 

Developed by Auroch Digital (Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun) in partnership with Warhammer and poncle (Vampire Survivors), discover the universes of Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar in all its pixel glory in this new surviv-a-ton.

releases.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
releases.summary:
The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends.

Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

releases.name: Hozy
releases.summary:
After things don’t quite work out in the big city, you return to your small hometown. Once lively, it now feels a little faded and forgotten. In that stillness, you discover something unexpected: a new passion. Room by room, space by space, you clean, paint, and gently restore the sense of community that once filled these streets.

Hozy is about slowing down. There are no timers, scores, penalties, and absolutely no stress or pressure. Just you, your tools, and the simple joy of making spaces beautiful again. Whether you're wiping windows, repainting walls, or finding the perfect spot for a sofa, everything is designed to keep you in a calm, satisfying flow.

Wrap yourself in a cozy atmosphere where every small action and detail matters. Open a window to let the wind play with floating dust and bring nature's sounds closer. Light candles, arrange books on shelves, paint a portrait on the wall, or switch on a projector. Everything you touch and every choice you make delivers a sense of satisfaction and a gentle “aha!” moment.

releases.name: Peak the Hills
releases.summary: Eight mountains. One truck. No shortcuts.Peak the Hills is a calm, careful off-road driving game about reaching the summit. There are no rivals and no timer pressure: the challenge is the mountain itself. Read the terrain, choose your line and place every wheel with care.When the track runs out, solve the obstacle with the gear in your truck:• Lay wooden planks across gaps and crawl over them, wheel by wheel• Winch your way up steep ramps and out of mud, using trees, rocks, ground anchors and a pulley• Lift a wheel over a rock sill with the jack• Dig through mud and snow with the shovel and grip with traction boardsEight hand-built mountains, each with its own surfaces and obstacles: Pine Ridge, Rain Valley, Red Canyon, Abandoned Mine, White Pass, Misty Forest, Storm Shoulder and the Final Summit.• Checkpoint camps and automatic saves: a mistake never ends your climb• Results for every summit: total time, driving time and recoveries• Vibration for terrain, impacts and the winch on the wireless controller; trigger effect on the PlayStation®5 console• Adjustable steering, camera and UI scale settings• Single player, offline

releases.name: Ultimate Theater Simulator
releases.summary: Ultimate Theater Simulator is a first-person cinema management game where you screen movies, serve snacks, hire staff, handle chaos, and grow your dream theater from the ground up.

releases.name: One Button Arcade
releases.summary: Welcome to One Button Arcade: a neon-lit hall of five brand-new arcade games, and every one of them is played with just one button.Each cabinet is its own world with its own twist on "press":• ORBIT HOPPER: let go of a planet's pull at just the right moment and hop across the galaxy.• BEE LINE: hold to fly a busy bumblebee through a summer meadow and bring the pollen home to the hive.• TOPSY-TURVY BUTLER: flip gravity to send a very proper butler racing across the floors and ceilings of a haunted manor.• FLIP SIDE DINER: wind up and toss pancakes so they land with exactly the right number of flips.• FROG CHOIR: croak back the Maestro's rhythms in time with the band at a moonlit pond party.Five seconds to learn, forever to master. Chase high scores on every cabinet's online leaderboard, unlock 70 trophies including the Platinum, win prize tickets, and switch on Assist mode whenever you want a gentler pace.New cabinets will arrive as optional add-ons, each with its own game, leaderboard and trophies.

releases.name: Checkers Master
releases.summary:
From the creators of Chess and for fans of classic board games, we bring you Checkers. Also known as "Draughts", the origins of which are so ancient that a board resembling this game was found dated back to 3,000 BC in the city-state of "Ur" of the ancient Mesopotamia.

You can play either against the smart Ai (artificial intelligence) player or against another person.

With stunning 3D graphics you will feel you are playing on a real checkers board and you can play using either the joy-con or the touch screen

Checkers has a selection of different boards and pieces to choose from.

releases.name: Don't Be Afraid 2
releases.summary:
15 years ago, David went through a nightmare. Kidnapped by a pair of deviant serial murderers and forced to take part in their deadly games, the young boy miraculously survived and escaped what he thought would be his final resting place.

For years, David tried to pick up the pieces and deal with the damage those events left on him. Unable to keep a job, find a partner, or even handle simple daily tasks, he leads a pitiful life under the watchful eye of his therapist.

And despite his desperate attempts, his past might catch up to him sooner than he expected

Don't Be Afraid 2 is a first person perspective horror game and a sequel to the 2020 game of the same title. Take on the role of David, a young man trying to cope with terrible trauma from his childhood, and dive deep into his fears and nightmares.

Relive the darkest moments of David's life while exploring the horrific locations, gathering clues about his past and solving puzzles left behind by the deranged murderer toying with his life.

releases.name: Shelterra the Skyworld
releases.summary: Explore a floating continent in a fantasy JRPG! Journey across an open world, conquer dungeons in turn-based battles, learn new skills by fighting enemies, and summon powerful Artifacts to aid you. Uncover the secrets of the Skyworld and save Shelterra from falling!

releases.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
releases.summary:
Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

Race around the board in Monopoly Jr., where every dice roll can help you grab cool places, collect money, and become the last player standing. Put on your detective hat in Clue Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Then jump into The Game of Life Jr., spin the spinner, drive your car along the path, and collect stars as you go.

Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.

Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!

releases.name: Ice Cream Simulator
releases.summary: Run your dream ice cream shop in Ice Cream Simulator! Create delicious ice cream using a variety of ingredients, manage your business, hire staff, decorate your store, handle changing weather and different customers, and enjoy a relaxing first-person simulation experience.

releases.name: Citizen Sleeper: Helion Collection
releases.summary:
The Helion Collection brings together the award-winning Citizen Sleeper, a gripping adventure inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, which has you living the life of an escaped worker as you attempt to survive on a lawless space station and its sequel, Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector, a dice-driven RPG where you get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.
About Citizen Sleeper
Roleplaying in the ruins of interplanetary capitalism. Live the life of an escaped worker, washed-up on a lawless station at the edge of an interstellar society. Inspired by the flexibility and freedom of TTRPGs, explore the station, choose your friends, escape your past and change your future.
About Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
A dice-driven RPG, in a human and heartfelt sci-fi world. You are an escaped android, with a malfunctioning body, a price on your head and no memory of your past. Get a ship, find a crew, and take on contracts while you navigate across the Starward Belt.

releases.name: CRYMELIGHT
releases.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

releases.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
releases.summary:
Do you have what it takes to catch "The Epiphany Killer"?

Step into the world of "Next of Kin: Epiphany," where you become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

In the thrilling conclusion to the "Next of Kin" trilogy, you'll explore atmospheric locations, interrogate suspects with the powerful new "Expose" system, and unravel the chilling truth behind the notorious "Epiphany Killer".

releases.name: Don Bradman Cricket Jr
releases.summary: FAST. FUN. CRICKET! Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot. Don Bradman Cricket Jr is fast, accessible cricket that's easy to learn and rewarding to master. Smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.

releases.name: Cleaning Simulator
releases.summary:
Cleaning Simulator invites you to grab your mop, vacuum cleaner, and sponge for a delightful cleaning adventure. Dirty floors, mountains of dishes, buzzing flies, dusty carpets, and chaotic rooms... They’re all waiting for you. But don’t worry - if you’ve got the right tools in hand, this mess will be sparkling clean in no time.

Whether you play just to unwind or aim to complete every task and earn the title of Cleaning Master, the game lets you play your own way. Mop the floors, scrub surfaces with the sponge, load the dishwasher, take out the trash, spray the flies, vacuum the carpets, organize scattered items, and blast away stubborn grime with a pressure washer!

Watching the environment transform as you clean is truly satisfying. And with HDR and ray tracing enabled, the way light gleams off those spotless surfaces… It actually makes you want to clean.

releases.name: Zero Caliber 2 Remastered
releases.summary: Zero Caliber 2 Remastered brings the full VR shooter experience to PC - with intense, cinematic firefights, a full single player and Co-op campaign, PvP, a huge arsenal to unlock, and character customization to make you stand out. Wishlist it if you’re after a proper VR shooter. Dropping Q3.

releases.name: Alex the Rabbit
releases.summary:
Alex the Rabbit is a classic, fun, and challenging 2D platformer.

Join Alex, a brave rabbit, on an action-packed adventure through colorful and dangerous worlds.

Your goal is to collect all the carrots scattered across the map, overcome obstacles and enemies, and find the Golden Carrot, located at the end of each level.

The game features 20 carefully crafted levels, increasing the challenge with each level, as well as 4 epic boss battles that will test your skills and reflexes.

If you enjoy retro-style platformers with classic gameplay and engaging progression, Alex the Rabbit is the perfect choice!

releases.name: Forefront
releases.summary: Forefront is an intense VR shooter featuring 32-player large-scale battles, land, sea, and air vehicles, and immersive, tactical combat. You are the tip of the spear in the war between a global energy giant and resistance forces. Which side will you take?

releases.name: HELL OF FEAR: Mind Breach
releases.summary: Step into the boots of Major Axel Vex in this survival horror descent into deep space. You embark on a mission to investigate a distress signal coming from Cengona Base. What starts off as a simple mission quickly turns into a terrifying, action-packed fight for survival.

releases.name: Faraway
releases.summary: You are a shooting star that refuses its fate of disappearing in the ether, to instead go travel space and draw constellations through its journey. Faraway is a one-button game, with a simple set of rules finely balanced to adapt to different playing levels, within an always renewed universe that is procedurally generated in real time - based on score -, resulting in an infinitely replayable game. Like Steph Thirion's first game Eliss, Faraway is set in a bizarre and lonely outer space, was 100% created - design, coding, music and sound - by one person, and all its graphics are drawn by code, resulting in a rarely personal sensory experience.

releases.name: Yomawari: The Long Night Collection
releases.summary: Twice the fright. Traverse the haunting world of Yomawari: Night Alone as a young girl searches for her sister, then share in the terror facing schoolgirls Yui and Haru in Yomawari: Midnight Shadows. Uncover the mysteries plaguing a rural Japanese town, hide from the things lurking in the night, and maybe get home alive.

releases.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
releases.summary:
Welcome to Escape Academy, the world’s foremost clandestine educator in the art of Escape. Whether you’re a returning student or a new pupil, you’ve come to the right place. 

Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School evolves the escape room format of the first game into a whole new GENRE: This is the first open world escape room game, and it's available right in the comfort of your own home.

In Escape Academy 2, the campus is one big puzzle room. Between classes, explore a sprawling, secret-filled hub with mysterious passage ways, hidden tunnels, and dangerous traps. Or chill out with your pals and take in all the vibes that student life has to offer.

releases.name: Yomawari: Lost in the Dark
releases.summary:
To break a curse placed upon her, a young girl must venture into the haunted streets of her town at night to search for her lost memories while evading
the twisted spirits that lurk in the darkness.

releases.name: LIGHT: Black Cat & Amnesia Girl
releases.summary:
In the adventure of "LIGHT", you take on the role of a mysterious black cat who leads an exciting adventure for a little girl who has lost her memory.

Set in a dark and spooky fantasy, explore this world with care as you face the omnipresent dark monsters.

As a cat, there's only so much you can do, so do your best to guide the little girl to solve the puzzle that leads to the exit. Look around carefully and be careful not to let her make the wrong decision.

releases.name: LightQb
releases.summary:
You are forced to take part in an experiment you didn't sign up for. Trapped in an unknown space, you must dash and survive through a grid-like world filled with light cubes, each with unique mechanics.

Use cubes, lasers, and portals to your advantage as you blaze through levels at incredible speeds, but beware, there might be more to this world than meets the eye.

The cycle continues until you master your path to the end or give up. Oh, and did I mention there’s someone taunting you every time you die?

releases.name: Revenant : In Memory Of The Day
releases.summary: You are heading down an endless corridor in search of a missing child. Pay close attention to your surroundings to find clues about the child, and find a way to escape the dark, confined corridor.

releases.name: Where the Seeds Fall
releases.summary:
The earth has been afflicted with Blight, forcing humanity to build new homes upon the branches of the World Tree.

It is a place fraught with peril, and in their fear, humanity has branded "Fell Children" as omens of disaster. After encountering a Fell Child, however, one soldier goes against orders and resolves to escort them to the surface world.

Navigate crumbling platforms, brace against strong winds, and make sure you land on steady ground. On the precarious branches of the World Tree, one misstep could spell your doom.

As you explore the World Tree, uncover the truth behind the Fell Child to learn what - and who - your journey is truly about.

releases.name: Kingdom of Night
releases.summary:
One night, in 1987, in the small town of Miami, Arizona, a satanic cult unwittingly summons the ancient evil, Baphomet, catapulting the town into chaos. John, awoken by the kidnapping of his neighbor, sets out into the night to fight back against the demonic invasion and rescue his friends before it's too late...

Take control of John as his adventure leads him through an hour-by-hour experience of what could be everyone's last night on Earth. As John, you will encounter unearthly evils, Demon lords, afflicted townsfolk, high school bullies, and a torrent of engaging, serial-like side stories - all nested in a larger-than-life fantasy that brings the ultimate evil to a neighborhood near you.

Choose your class, customize your abilities, and battle nightmarish creatures as you collect unique gear in order to infiltrate the massive lairs of Demon lords that have taken over the town.
